rows.en: You know who I am, right? C'mon, OOO!!
Umm...
Gaaah! I told you, I'm not your enemy!!
...Right?
Oh, come on, quit playin' dumb. You know me, don't ya?
...Hey, don't you ignore me!!
Sempai, leave this to me.
We're Imagin. We're in the middle of carrying out a certain important mission, but...
we've run into a bit of a problem.
Somethin's gone wrong with the "flow of time." We were lookin' into it.
Then out of nowhere, we got jumped by an Imagin called Negataros. A real nasty-looking type.
Yeah, yeah! And that guy's a real smug piece of work, too!!
Sempai, you keep quiet.
Shut it, Turtle! Let me talk too!!
Anyway, that Nega-whatsit went and stole our Pass!!
Huh? "What's a Pass?"... you say?
Den-O's Rider Pass, obviously!?
And the spare Rider Pass too!!
That bastard! He made off with both of 'em!! Grrrrr!!
Thanks to that, we can't become Den-O... You'll cry.
We want to beat Negataros and take them back, but we just can't find him.
We're in a real bind here, y'know.
Of course you'll help us, right!? I don't care about your answer though!!
...Wait a moment. Did you come here of your own will?
...Hold on a sec. Did you guys come here of your own free will?
...Wait a minute. Did you guys get all the way here on your own?
...Hold it. Did you come here of your own will?
...Whoa, whoa. You're tellin' me you guys got here under your own power?
Nah, nah, no way!
We were chasin' Negataros, and we just happened to end up here.
Normally an Imagin escapes across time, but something's off this time.
It looks like we didn't end up in another time, but in another world.
Aaargh! I wanna get outta this crazy place already!
But this world's fun, huh~ There's lots of weirdos here!!
A ghost that's just a hand...!? That's gotta be Ankh.
Come to think of it, I saw a fella earlier who looked just like you.
Someone who looks just like me...?
Someone who looks just like me...?
He was fightin' a monster, yellin' "My hand is burnin' red~" or some such.
There was also a fella fightin' a monster, yellin' "My hand is burnin' red~" or some such.
Who...? There are other Gundams here too...?
Who...? There are other Gundams here too...?
Who cares about that stuff!! Let's hurry up, get the Pass back and go home!!
I wonder if everyone's worried about us~
Idiot! We're the ones who should be worried! They're prob'ly blubberin' on their own right now!
They'll be fine. They've got Zeronos and Deneb with them.
You have other friends?
Back in our world. They're investigating as a separate team.
I see.
Well, that's the deal. If you find Negataros, let us know!!
Sigh... What a noisy bunch...
Jeez... That bunch is about as far from hard-boiled as it gets...
They seemed to be having fun, same as ever.
Sigh... What a noisy bunch...
Waste Yummies!?
Just the right sparring partners. Go! Waste Yummies!
Hmm, Waste Yummies, huh... Well, they look good enough to keep them in check, at least.
...Hmph. Weak one by one, so they win with numbers, huh?
Kazari! Uva! Even the Greeeds have come to this world...!!
Hey there, OOO. Fancy running into you in a place like this.
Huh? Ankh isn't with you?
Ankh!? So Ankh's over here too after all!?
Probably, don't you think? He's the persistent type.
Anyway, there are some interesting desires swirling around in the "Cube."
The desires of the folks here are well worth unleashing.
Heh heh... We're already putting them to good use.
You'd better watch your back!
See ya.
Wait!!
...They've already made Yummies?
Waste Yummies!?
Just the right sparring partners. Go! Waste Yummies!
Hmm... Well, they look good enough to keep them in check, at least.
...Hmph. Weak one by one, so they win with numbers, huh?
You're OOO's friends, aren't you? Fancy running into you in a place like this.
Huh? Ankh isn't with you?

notes.note: Momotaros is protesting to the wary party (not OOO) that he isn't an enemy; 'your enemy' chosen.
Senpai rendered 'Sempai' (Urataros's standard address for Momotaros in Den-O fan subs); used again in #0.15.
Den-O term for the operation of time rendered as 'the flow of time'. Kintaros's Kansai speech done with light dropped g's.
Momotaros's nickname for Urataros (turtle + mocking suffix) rendered 'Turtle' as a name-like insult.
Momotaros echoes an unvoiced question from the party ('What's a Pass?').
Kintaros's catchphrase kept as 'You'll cry.' per glossary, here used as a lament.
Ryutaros's catchphrase rendered per glossary: 'I don't care about your answer'.
No speaker recovered; voice (rough speech, wants out) fits Momotaros. Line is speaker-neutral in English.
No speaker recovered; inferred OOO (Eiji) recognising Ankh. The referent (someone mentioning a hand-only ghost) is likely in the skipped row #0.37, not in this slice.
Quote of God Gundam/Domon's 'My hand is burning red' line (Shining/God Finger chant) kept recognisable; #0.43 is the Gundam-leader variant ('looked like you'), #0.44 the other-leader variant.
Literally 'that's my line': Momotaros says he's the one who should worry about the others; rendered by meaning. 'They' = the friends back home (Ryotaro etc.), not named in source.
Zeronos and Deneb are not in the glossary; standard English franchise names used.
OOO (Eiji) has met the Imagin before (crossover film), hence 'same as ever'.
??? summoner unidentified; kept gender-neutral (no pronouns needed). Same for #0.30.
Source verb means 'hold in check/harass'; 'them' = OOO's side. Same in #0.31.
Eiji realises Yummies have already been spawned from people's desires here (following Kazari's 'already making use of them'); subject 'they' = the Greeeds restored.
No speaker recovered; non-OOO party variant of #0.3. Speaker-neutral line.

report: All 80 rows translated. Uncertain: 0122#0.36 and #0.39 and 0123#0.29 had no recovered speaker; inferred Momotaros / OOO / party member. Names not in glossary: Zeronos, Deneb (standard English names); 'Sempai' honorific kept.
